Proton SpeedHack 8.0-5 with WMV playback components from GE-Proton8-16. Reported working in **Fatal Frame / Project Zero: Maiden of Black Water** on Steam Deck by the repository owner, including cutscene playback and the speedhack.

### Download and install

Download **Proton-SpeedHack8-WMV.zip** below (the installable package, not GitHub's Source code archives).

1. In Steam Deck Desktop Mode, extract the ZIP into `~/.steam/root/compatibilitytools.d/`.
2. Restart Steam.
3. Select **Proton-SpeedHack8-WMV** in the game's Properties → Compatibility settings.

For 3× speed toggled with Page Up, use:

```text
SPEEDHACK_SPEED=3 SPEEDHACK_TOGGLE=1 SPEEDHACK_KEYS=page_up %command%
```

Map a Steam Input button to Page Up. Test cutscene playback at normal speed first. Audio time stretching is not added.

### What changed

- Preserves every original SpeedHack Wine binary, its timing changes, DXVK, VKD3D, and existing GStreamer plugins.
- Adds GE 8-16's FFmpeg codec libraries and ASF reader for both architectures: 18 files/library links.
- Changes one launcher operation so bundled codec libraries take priority over Steam's video libraries.
- Adds a distinct Steam name, codec licenses, and source references.

### Validation

- Original-runtime audit: 6,606 entries unchanged; none replaced.
- User-supplied Fatal Frame WMV3 sample: all 2,028 video frames decoded locally.
- GitHub tests: 32-bit and 64-bit WMV3 video/WMA2 audio decoding, plus 1× → 3× → 1× Wine timing.
- ZIP integrity and SHA-256 verified.

Other games and all cutscenes have not been exhaustively tested. The game video is not included.

[Validated build and logs](https://github.com/sevansup/Proton-SpeedHack8-WMV/actions/runs/38171535880). The checksum, file audit, and test output are attached separately.

Thanks to [LtSquigs](https://github.com/LtSquigs/Proton-SpeedHack) for Proton SpeedHack and [GloriousEggroll](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom) for GE-Proton. See the included codec license/source notices for exact upstream revisions.
